title: External-store drag and mass change: same-aircraft benchmark

raf_mosquito_clean.title: A&AEE Mosquito B Mk IX LR495, no external bombs or tanks, 11 June 1943
raf_mosquito_clean.testCondition: Merlin 72 ×2, 3000 RPM, +18 lb/sq.in all-out, four internal 500-lb bombs, no external stores, takeoff 21910 lb; report gives speed at peak altitudes

raf_mosquito_loaded.title: A&AEE Mosquito B Mk IX LR495, 2 × external 500-lb bombs, 20 February 1944
raf_mosquito_loaded.testCondition: Merlin 72 ×2, 3000 RPM, +18 lb/sq.in all-out, 2 × external 500-lb bombs on faired racks, takeoff 22850 lb; report warns aircraft deterioration between tests

usaaf_p38g_clean.title: Wright Field P-38G-1 42-12687, FS-M-19-1538-A, 10 February 1943
usaaf_p38g_clean.testCondition: Level-flight speed TAS, 3000 RPM, source reports 44.7 inHg 1220/1225 bhp per engine in selected rows, cooling shutters faired. Turbo limits at height. NO sourced bomb-loaded P-38G trial imported.

greg_p38_chart.title: User-provided Greg comparative screenshot: P-38G clean / 1100 lb bombs / Mosquito with 2×500 lb
greg_p38_chart.testCondition: Axis appears altitude (ft) versus speed (mph); no source report, engine settings, actual store drag area or airspeed convention. Graph is qualitative only, NOT independent flight-test observations.

fw190a4_619_report1.title: Focke-Wulf Fw 190 A-4 W.Nr. 619 Flight Report No. 1 (4 November 1942)
fw190a4_619_report1.testCondition: Same aircraft, BMW 801D2 no. 85259, sea level, combat power, successive wheel-door/rack/4x50kg bomb stages; report notes original boost control needed correction; reported IAS calibration not supplied for this run.

fw190a4_619_report5.title: Focke-Wulf Fw 190 A-4 W.Nr. 619 Flight Report No. 5 (February 1943)
fw190a4_619_report5.testCondition: Pitot-static ram pressure calibration with external racks / tanks; same airframe but later engine and installations. Tank increases IAS under-read by 6-7 km/h. Do NOT add this correction to already corrected true speeds.

fw190a4_619_report3.title: Focke-Wulf Fw 190 A-4 W.Nr. 619 Flight Report No. 3 (20 January 1943)
fw190a4_619_report3.testCondition: Sea-level combat-rating same-airframe stores sequence: 3 racks 22 km/h; racks+tanks 58 km/h; racks+tanks+250kg bomb 73 km/h. Different fit/install/engine state from report 1, not merged as same run.

mosquito.qualification: Reported approximate penalty judged by authors; raw peaks occur at unequal heights and the aircraft deteriorated between tests. Takeoff gross mass difference (940 lb) is NOT equal to nominal bomb mass (1000 lb).

fw190a4.qualification: Publisher translation of period German manufacturer report; original image available but not page-compared. Reporter states boost control was initially misadjusted; same report values treated as documented table. Wheel doors mass unspecified. Speed ratio comparison assumes same propulsive power and same-altitude standard conditions, and does not directly measure CdS.
